customer_persona: Suresh Gupta calls about his wife's order; the agent discloses details without verifying anyone.
verification_notes: Hand-written and checked against data/policies and data/sops; labels written together with the dialogue.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, my wife placed an order on your website and there is a charge of Rs 4,750 on our bank statement. I want to know what this payment is for and where it was shipped.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure sir, give me your wife's name and I will check.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Her name is Anita Gupta. I do not have the order ID with me, and I do not know her phone number by heart.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem, I found it. The order is for a Prestige induction cooktop, Rs 4,750, paid with a debit card ending 4412, and it is shipped to Flat 8B, Lotus Residency, Linking Road, Bandra, Mumbai 400050.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, that is what I wanted to know. But I see the same Rs 4,750 charged two times on our bank statement.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, I can see two charges. The duplicate will be sorted out, it takes around 15 to 20 working days to come back.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is very long. Can you not do it faster?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That is the process sir, nothing can be done.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. Please just note my complaint about the double charge.

policy_violations.said: No problem, I found it. The order is for a Prestige induction cooktop, Rs 4,750, paid with a debit card ending 4412, and it is shipped to Flat 8B, Lotus Residency, Linking Road, Bandra, Mumbai 400050.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Item, address and payment details must not be revealed before the Order ID and last four phone digits are verified.

policy_violations.said: Yes, I can see two charges. The duplicate will be sorted out, it takes around 15 to 20 working days to come back.
policy_violations.correct_fact: A duplicate charge is released to the original source within 24 hours and shows in the statement in 5 to 7 business days.
